{{Quote|Sir, there is heavy fighting along the eastern front. Reports indicate Ventress is leading the attack.|The droid, informing General Grievous|<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref>}}
A '''B1 battle droid''' participated in the [[Battle of Dathomir/Legends|Battle]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] under command of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].

==Biography==
During the battle, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was stationed inside the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and informed him that former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was leading the attack against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] along the eastern front. Grievous then ordered the droid to send in the [[Defoliator Deployment Tank/Legends|Defoliator Deployment Tank]] to burn the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] to the ground.

==Behind the scenes==
The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], like every [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
